column1: # lane-v2 flip manifest — WS-P flip machinery (docs/design/flip-ladder.md §4).
# Schema v1. One data row per DEFAULT-FLIPPED ShapeClass:
#   class <TAB> allowed_reasons
#     class           = stats.rs ShapeClass::name() (the lane vocabulary)
#     allowed_reasons = comma-list of RefuseReason::name() values that stay
#                       LEGAL for the class after its flip (the dynamic gates:
#                       epq, instrumented, ...; backward retired, B11); "-" = none.
# A flip commit adds its row here AND in the compiled-in ASSERT_MANIFEST
# (lanev2/census.rs) AND reseeds the class's lane-gates floors — all in the
# SAME commit, both gate profiles (the WS-P floors law; the census.rs
# `manifest_mirror_in_sync` unit pins this file to the compiled manifest).
# Layer-A assert mode (PGRUST_LANE_V2_ASSERT_COVERED=1, dualexec/e2e channels
# only) raises `volcano-unreachable:` (PgError XX000) when a class listed
# here refuses with a reason outside its allowed_reasons list.
# Wave-4 rows (flip-ladder §3 rungs 1-3; the binding wave-4 flip manifest):
#   FLIP-1 rowmode  — projectset + 16 of the 17 row-mode tail delegation
#                     classes (dynamic host-template gates; projectset keeps
#                     its structural child refuse + the permanent
#                     explicit-OFF wholesale refuse; the six T3-hostable
#                     shapes keep env-off, the per-shape SCANS_T3 force-off
#                     spelling).
#                     G2 OMISSIONS, BY DESIGN (ledgered,
#                     notes/se-wave4-tierA.md): subqueryscan — the 17th tail
#                     class — flips with rung 1 (tail e2e asserts its ON-arm
#                     ownership; local floor ratcheted 4 -> 29000) but gets
#                     NO row: it is a MIXED-HOST class — the pre-existing
#                     master-knob (PGRUST_LANE_V2) wave-4 glue also ticks
#                     SubqueryScan refusals with open-ended child-derived
#                     reasons (scan_child_fusible), so any closed
#                     allowed_reasons list would false-raise in assert mode;
#                     its row lands with the master-knob flip, when that
#                     reason set closes. `result` gets no row because it is
#                     master-knob-gated, not ROWMODE-gated — genuinely not a
#                     flipped class this wave.
#   FLIP-2 mergejoin — pure delegation, dynamic gates only
#   FLIP-3 windowagg — W1 dynamic gates + the W1 structural refuses (the
#                     sticky-batch lane owns only its admitted family)
